svg.title: Why the external evidence did not become a clean wage panel
svg.desc: Most external records could not enter clean wage comparisons because side, basis, identity, or conflict gates were unresolved. Correct exclusion protects comparability; it is not evidence of a wage effect.

g.text: Why the external evidence did not become a clean wage panel

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Unresolved side, basis, identity, and conflict holds remain outside clean comparisons

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Unit: administrative record or declared candidate group • hold denominators shown in each panel • Evidence: strict compatibility gates

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Holds are correct exclusions; the 201 unresolved high-impact conflicts never enter clean headline calculations.
